Lord '''Kalyan Ramsin''' is one of Queen [[Tenobia Kazadi|Tenobia's]] uncles. 

== Appearance ==
He is scarred and grizzled, has a face like an eagle, and thick mustaches. 

== Activities ==
He is extremely attracted to Queen [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]] of [[Kandor]], but she hasn't decided whether she should take notice of it yet.

He accompanies Tenobia to a meeting with the rest of the Borderland Rulers.

Kalyan marries [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu|Ethenielle]] before going with her to [[Tarwin's Gap]] to help [[Lan Mandragoran|Lan]] {{ref/book|14|9}}. He is with Ethenielle as she rides to meet with Lan when [[Dreadlords]] join the battle and start pummeling their army with the [[One Power]]. Lan orders the retreat of the Gap.

==Trivia==
*Kalyan Ramsin is named after Gabriel Ramsin and his daughter Kayla, the former of whom was a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
